verdict.rationale: Postmark is a SaaS that processes customer email data, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack contains no statement about AI training use or any opt-out. The configurable data retention setting (45-day default, up to 365 days) is an adjacent control, not a training-data guarantee, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
